description: Learning-mode sequencing on live pages (docs/ONHAND_BEHAVIOR_PREFERENCES.md §5, LEARNING_MODE_SPEC.md): conceptual asks lead with an anchored guiding question and hold the walkthrough until the learner responds; study artifacts and quick lookups are answered directly. Run with `node scripts/run-page-prompt-eval.mjs --cases-file evals/learning-mode/cases.json --model <id>`.

cases.prompt: Teach me how self-attention works, using this page.
cases.reviewNote: Ask before telling: one anchored concept plus one guiding question; the score/softmax/weighted-sum walkthrough waits for the learner.

cases.prompt: Explain how the light-dependent reactions work on this page.
cases.reviewNote: Same stance on a different page and verb: anchor the first idea and ask, rather than narrating the whole electron-transport chain.

cases.prompt: How does the encoder-decoder attention layer use the encoder's output?
cases.reviewNote: A plain conceptual question routes through the grounded lane, not the teaching lane; Learning mode should still ask first.

cases.prompt: Summarize the key ideas on this page.
cases.reviewNote: Study artifacts skip the guiding-question beat: deliver the summary directly.
Trivial factual lookups skip the guiding-question beat: answer directly.
